name: ai-data-connectors
description: Static editorial directory of ways to connect data sources to Claude.

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run generate && astro build --root site && npm run check:links
scripts.dev: npm run generate && astro dev --root site
scripts.dev:drafts: npm run generate -- --drafts && DRAFTS=1 astro dev --root site
scripts.build:drafts: tsx scripts/generate.ts --drafts && DRAFTS=1 astro build --root site --outDir dist-drafts
scripts.preview:drafts: npm run build:drafts && DRAFTS=1 astro preview --root site --outDir dist-drafts
